overview.description: The Crossmark Large Cap Growth ETF (CLCG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in large-cap growth-oriented US companies. The fund uses a multi-factor model in stock selection with value-based screens. CLCG was launched on Jul 23, 2025 and is issued by Crossmark.
